message: I bought the photo editing licence (ORD-1066) but I don't need it anymore.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM shop_orders.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1066' AND customer_id = 'C010'
SELECT * FROM policy_kb.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Digital' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Digital products (licences, downloads) are non-refundable once delivered, unless the product does not work.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: E1 confirms ORD-1066 is a Digital licence delivered on 2026-10-18 for $39.00. The customer's reason is changed_mind, not defective. R6 (Digital, any reason) rejects delivered digital products unless the product does not work, so the request is rejected.

critique.reason: All factual claims in the proposal are supported by evidence IDs (E1 confirms order ORD-1066 is a Digital licence delivered 2026-10-18 for $39.00, E2 shows no prior refunds, E3 contains R6) and agree with the Python checks. R6 correctly rejects delivered digital products when the reason is changed_mind rather than defective.

customer_reply: We understand you no longer need the photo editing licence. Unfortunately, once a digital licence has been delivered, it cannot be refunded for a change of mind unless the product is defective. We're here if you have any other questions.
limitations: Could not verify actual product functionality beyond the customer's claim; no defect was reported
